info.name: AlexH's Google Voice Dark
info.description: It's more complete than most dark mode scripts out there (so long as Google doesn't break something), and does its best to fit in with all of their other official dark mode web application offerings.
info.additionalInfo: Nothing fancy here, just simple, easy on the eyes, Google Voice Dark Mode, the way you wish Google would do it themselves already... More areas of Google Voice are properly "dark modded" using this script than most other's currently available on the open market.  Enjoy.
